issues.detail: PA 1/2026 (Mar 2026): 90 contract harvesters vs 90 required, 1 per 23 ha. Agro 1/2026 (Feb 2026): 69 harvesters, a shortfall of 27. Agro 2/2026 says the estate now has the optimum number.

issues.title: Cost of production % below budget stated three ways
issues.detail: PA 1/2026: RM221.97 vs RM345.54/t budget. Section 9.1 says 46% below, concluding remark 13.13 says 32% below; the figures give 36%. RM totals (534,116.21 + 770,828.00 + 810,952.00 = 2,115,896.21 ÷ 9,523.75 t) give RM222.17/t; general charges RM534,116.21 ÷ 9,523.75 = RM56.08/t vs printed 55.88.

issues.title: Manuring % and required totals
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 Table 12 prints 86.85% for Q1 (applied ÷ delivered is 86.36%); applied vs programme is 489.85 ÷ 750.00 = 65% (the text says 65%). 2026 requirement: Agro 1/2026 Table 6 3,168.90 t; Agro 2/2026 Table 5 2,746.00 t; Agro 1/2026 Table 6 shows 100% done with nothing applied. PA Table 12 lists Mix A in January; programme puts it in February.

issues.title: Circle weeding 71% claim
issues.detail: Agro 2/2026 5.4.3 says 2,718.60 ha completed is about 71% of the overall programme; PA year programme is 6,269.80 ha (3 rounds), so 2,718.60 is 43% of the year. Round 1 100%, round 2 31%. PA Table 9 year programme rows (e.g. P17G 818.30 ha) do not equal 3 × hectares (803.10).

issues.title: Barn owl percentages copied from February
issues.detail: Agro 2/2026 Table 13 (Jul 2026): P10A 36 of 40 boxes occupied but 100% printed; P15B 23/25 (100%), P17E 20/21 (100%), P17G 23/24 (100%), P18H 24/26 (100%); total 173/189 = 92% is right. PA 1/2026: 170 boxes, 163 occupied (96%), required 174.

issues.title: P17G area and estate yield basis
issues.detail: Agro 2/2026 Appendix 3(a) still uses P17G 275.30 ha and 2,087.40 ha (2026 9.32 t/ha, P17G 8.56; 2025 P17G 21.52), while Table 15 uses 267.70 and 2,079.80 ha (9.36, P17G 8.81). PA uses 267.70 (P17G 2025 22.13 t/ha). Agro 2/2026 Table 3 previous P17G hectarage 275.30 makes the estate total 2,095.00, not the printed 2,087.40.

issues.title: Mislabelled and inconsistent text
issues.detail: Agro 2/2026 Table 16 cumulative rounds headed '2025' but values (14.00–14.30) are to July 2026. PA 1/2026 Table 1 headed '2005 vs 2026'; summary page headed 'P. A Report 2/2025'; Table 22 is labelled 'cost of production' but is crop production. Section 2.1 says mature area 'decreased' after 7.60 ha was planted. PA mill effluent photo refers to 'P18G' (no such field). Agro 1/2026 says EFB covered 329.27 ha = 39% of P10A (table 84%); Agro 2/2026 nutrient spec gives kieserite as '27% P2O5' and compound as '14:113:9:2.5'. PA rainfall 2022 total 2,384.05 vs 2,384.5. PA says last palm census 2023, Agro says 2024. PR25I is 7.60 ha in area tables, 7.0 ha in the programme, 7.90 ha in Agro 1/2026 Table 3.

issues.title: Rat bait product differs
issues.detail: PA 1/2026: STORM (flocoumafen) used in P17E, 1 round, 222.70 ha by March. Agro 2/2026: 2,079.80 ha treated with brodifacoum each quarter. Agro 1/2026: 2025 baiting was flocoumafen, 3,550.22 ha.

issues.title: KPI percentages worked out
issues.detail: kpi.circlePct 44 = 795.90 ÷ 1,792.40 ha and selectivePct 88 = 1,837.70 ÷ 2,079.80 ha (PA 1/2026 Tables 9-10, Jan–Mar 2026, worked out); pruningPct 75 as printed (Table 19). By July (Agro 2/2026) circle round 2 was 31% and selective round 2 88%.

issues.title: Traps checked
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 'last year same period' (8,050.77 t, 3.86 t/ha) is a true Jan–Mar 2025 actual, and '2025' 52,122.17 t is a full 12 months (matches Agro monthly). General charges 2025 Table 7 covers 12 months. No Jan–Nov totals; no combined estates. Agro 2/2026 Appendix 3(b) 2026 Jan–Jul months add to the printed 19,460.82 t.
